title: Customer update
description:
The request body for updating a customer.

All fields are optional. Only the fields provided in the request will be updated.

:::note
`business_name` is not supported in this version of the API.
:::

Date-Of-Birth.description: The birth date of the customer.

Email.description: The email address of the customer.

Full-Name.description: The full name of the customer.

Phone.description: The phone number of the customer in [E.164 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164).
